text:
lee: quick thought from today's usability testing — folks miss the action on schema lint when it's in the run snack. they see the red dot but don't know how to get to the field.

tori: agree. maybe the snack should persist until dismissed and include a tiny chevron to expand an inline mini-diff. that way people can triage without leaving the run timeline.

devon: tiny keyboard/shortcut idea: press G to jump to next linted run, or press O to open the inline editor for the focused run. we should list shortcuts in the tooltip.

claire: accessibility note: when the inline mini-diff opens, announce via live-region: 'Schema issues for invocation 32, 2 problems'. also autofocus the first actionable button and trap focus inside the diff until closed. Escape should return focus to the run row.

lee: copy note — current pill uses 'Fix' which tests skewed: users expect auto-fix. prefer 'Review issues' or 'Open schema' as neutral. anonymous test users reacted badly to 'Fix'.

tori: +1 on 'Review issues'. add microcopy below: 'This will not change your model; it only shows suggested schema fixes.' small hint.

devon: implementation detail: expose json path and failing rule inline in monospace, max 120 chars. if it's long collapse with '...'. sample: 

```
payload.items[3].metadata.created_at: expected ISO8601, got '03-12-24'
```

That helped testers reproduce bugs quickly.

claire: color contrast — error chips should pass 4.5:1 even in compact mode. we have icon + color, but add a visible underline on hover for keyboard users.

lee: analytics ask: track CTA clicks (open editor, expand diff), keyboard opens, and dismisses. add event property 'lint_count' and 'first_issue_path' when available.

tori: UX detail — if a run has both function errors and schema issues, show two separate chips: 'Function error' and 'Schema: 2' so users know which tool failed.

devon: PR flow — I'll prototype without auto-save; changes in inline editor are preview-only and there will be a clear 'Apply to schema' button that opens full editor for commit. this avoids accidental overwrites.

claire: a11y-bot: please queue SR checklist once prototype link posted.

a11y-bot: queued: small-run-lint-audit. reminders set for Lee and Claire after figma link posted.

lee: ok action items: devon -> prototype + figma by Thu; tori -> copy + tooltip text; claire -> a11y checklist & contrast tests; i'll add analytics spec and update run-history component props. thanks all — this should make debugging tool-calls much less friction for new users. :sparkles:
